quotes.text: For instance, the Commission received copies of business visas given to Bangladeshi recruits, with mention that they had been invited by a civilian company in the Russian Federation.

sources.title: UN Commission press release on trafficking foreign recruits

quotes.text: With regard to the issue of the recruitment of foreign nationals to serve in the Russian armed forces, the Commission found compelling evidence that Russian authorities have trafficked persons from 29 countries.

sources.title: Prothom Alo: Bangladeshis forced into war in Russia

quotes.text: However, the report does not provide specific figures regarding the number of visas issued, the exact number of recruited Bangladeshis, their identities or their fates.

sources.title: The Daily Star: UN probe on Bangladeshis trafficked into Russian army

quotes.text: The UN report did not specify how many Bangladeshis had been trafficked, killed or reported missing.
